question: Does congruence-aware accumulation reduce structure-space growth on the real Lean-graph substrate, at preserved recall PER DECLARED QUERY CLASS - and does ungoverned (surface) congruence corrupt content while governed (witnessed) congruence does not?

substrate: Mechanical parse of formal/RaklFormal.lean (the tests/test_end_to_end_real_problem.py parse): every theorem with >= 1 dependency becomes a star-shaped ReducedStructure (deps -> name). Frozen at commit 08169241. Variant load: R=5 vocabulary-disjoint relabelings per base structure, each with its recorded bijection witness (the alpha-renaming analogue of equivalent presentations).

arms.A_atomic_shipped: The shipped rakl.structure_space.StructureSpace: accumulate appends every structure unconditionally; growth measured in newly-seen roles only.
arms.B1_surface_congruence: The tempting faithful-to-shape import: merge on the unlabeled shape key (relation count + degree multiset - exact isomorphism class on star graphs). No witness required. One representative per key; merge events recorded with content ids.
arms.B2_witnessed_congruence: The governed adaptation: merge ONLY when an explicit relabeling-bijection witness exists AND checks (applying the map reproduces the representative exactly - fail-closed). Witness maps stored, enabling query translation through the witness (the e-graph find() analogue).

loads.duplication_exhibit: Arm A only: accumulate every base structure twice (identical restatements). Expectation: role-growth reads flat on the second pass while stored-structure count doubles - the shipped-code duplication exposure named in the assimilation packet, measured on real substrate.
loads.variant_load: All arms: accumulate every base plus its R=5 witnessed relabelings, deterministic interleaved order.

declared_query_classes.JUMP_signature_retrieval: propose_analogies with a vocabulary-disjoint probe of each base's shape. Declared CONGRUENCE-INVARIANT: expected preserved in every arm.
declared_query_classes.role_exact_match: structure_space.match on a sampled variant's root role at floor authority. Declared NOT congruence-invariant without witnesses: expected to survive in A (stored directly) and in B2 (via witness translation), and to fail in B1 for variants merged without a witness.
